Get real-time joins and aggregations for your analytical and operational data:
ingest JSON, define schema for your entities (objects), and query them with full SQL - millions of rows, millisecond reads. Set a trigger and your agent (or any webhook) gets notified about changes in seconds. Signup takes one tool call, no browser needed.

How it works: 
- POST JSON to a source using `Ingest Events` and Frostlake durably archives every event. 
- Define an entity - a typed schema with field names, types, and a primary key - and Frostlake materialises your events into a real Postgres table, validated on arrival. Frostlake supports an evolving schema where columns are added/removed on-the-fly.
- Build a live table by writing any SQL SELECT over your entities: Frostlake keeps it incrementally up to date via CDC, no refresh job needed. 
- Attach a trigger to any entity or live table and a webhook fires within seconds of a row creation or field change.
